response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT s.zoneref AS zoneref, si.healtheval AS healtheval, AVG(s.gbsize * 1.0 / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS scan_count FROM scans s JOIN sites si ON si.zoneregistry = s.zoneref WHERE s.chronotag >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND s.chronotag <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY s.zoneref, si.healtheval), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_avg FROM g) SELECT g.zoneref AS site_code, g.healtheval AS health_safety_status, g.avg_ratio AS average_ratio, g.scan_count AS scan_count, g.avg_ratio - m.mean_avg AS excess_over_mean FROM g CROSS JOIN m WHERE m.mean_avg IS NOT NULL AND g.avg_ratio > m.mean_avg ORDER BY excess_over_mean DESC LIMIT 10
